name: papyrus
description: A LaTeX paper editor with live PDF preview and an AI co-author. Write in a split-pane editor, press Cmd+S (Ctrl+S on Windows and Linux) to compile with pdflatex or tectonic, and read the rendered PDF beside your source. Compilation errors are parsed into a clickable list that jumps to the offending line. Clone an existing paper from any git remote, then commit and push from the toolbar. The co-author panel is a real KiroCrew chat session scoped to the paper, so the agent can read and edit your LaTeX while you watch the PDF update.
author: tricatte
highlights: Split-pane LaTeX editor with a live PDF preview beside it
Compile on save (Cmd+S, or Ctrl+S on Windows and Linux) via pdflatex or tectonic, with the bibtex cycle run for you
No TeX installed? One click installs a verified Tectonic compiler into Papyrus’s own folder
Compiler errors and warnings parsed into a clickable list that jumps to the line
AI co-author chat scoped to the paper — it reads and edits the LaTeX you are looking at
Clone a paper from any git remote, then commit, pull, and push from the toolbar
Never runs the compiler with shell escape, so a hostile .tex file cannot execute commands
